policy_status: Defined before production residuals were examined

conventions.frame: Apparent topocentric body centres, WGS84, east-positive longitude
conventions.limb_radius_and_horizon_dip: None; these are centre-crossing diagnostics, not upper-limb rise/set
conventions.time: UTC; 2024 TAI-UTC=37 s; linear daily DUT1 and polar motion
conventions.illumination: Production elongation approximation compared separately with the same model and independent spherical phase-angle fraction

conditioning.classification_guard: Use each body's direction tolerance about horizon and observing thresholds; preserve indeterminate cases

event_search.window: 24 hours from 12:00 UTC, including a UTC date boundary; start inclusive, end exclusive
event_search.claim: Validation-only crossing searches over production altitude APIs; no existing native rise/set event API

rationale.angles: 5 arcsec Sun / 1 arcmin Moon are planner regression bounds allowing different builtin versus DE421 ephemerides; azimuth projection allowance below 85 deg, with direction bound always active
rationale.event_times: Direction bounds divided by minimum admitted crossing slope 0.5 arcsec/s give 10s Sun / 120s Moon; grazing events are explicitly ill-conditioned
rationale.illumination: 0.0003 absolute bounds numerical agreement of elongation model; 0.01 bounds its spherical phase approximation; relative errors near new Moon are undefined/unstable and not gated
rationale.darkness: 5 arcsec solar altitude propagates through 15/18 score points per degree to 0.00116 points, rounded conservatively to 0.002
